triage.note: Cold-reviewer finding T3-2 (tasks/reviews/gates-2026-08-22.json, MEDIUM, reviewer-stated), case added in PR #30 round 1 (finding R3: the first disposition pinned the fix only in normalize._demo, which the eval gate cannot see). ADR-024 rules Form 10-K/A OUT of scope and makes the refusal (`doc_status: unsupported`, `unsupported_form`) the behaviour that has to hold; for a primary .htm with no EDGAR SGML header -- every iXBRL-era filing in the corpus -- the cover-page sniff is the only signal, and FORM_SNIFF_RE's '(?:/A)?' alternative recognises an amendment only when the '/A' is byte-adjacent to the form token. A cover that typesets 'FORM 10-K' on one line and '(Amendment No. 1)' on the next -- a real filer layout -- sniffed as a plain 10-K and was fully parsed: 22 items, success_with_warning, on a document ADR-024 says must be refused. The fix (sniff_form appends '/A' when AMENDMENT_RE matches within AMENDMENT_REACH=80 normalized chars of the form token, either side) is a NEW code path in the refusal, which is exactly what ADR-024 §3 ('no new fixture, no new code path') did not foresee, so under hard rule 2 it needs a gate case rather than a layer assert alone; the ADR carries an amendment note recording this, and the _demo asserts stay for the two byte-adjacent routes.

provenance:
SELF-CREATED adversarial fixture: a copy of evals/fixtures/sandston-2021/filing.htm (Sandston Corp FY2021 10-K, iXBRL, no SGML header -- see that fixture's README row for original public-source provenance; fy2021-item9c derives from the same source) with ONE element inserted, 2026-08-22: immediately after the cover's form-type line ('FORM 10-K

', the single occurrence of that closing sequence, raw offset 20078) a 186-byte

whose style and wrapper are a byte-for-byte copy of that same line's markup, containing '(Amendment No. 1)'. 799,426 -> 799,612 bytes; the source contains 'Amendment No' 0x, the output '(Amendment No. 1)' 1x; nothing else is touched. After normalization the cover reads 'FORM 10-K (Amendment No. 1) (Mark One)...' -- the form token at normalized offset 103, the marker at 114, i.e. 11 chars apart, well inside AMENDMENT_REACH. WHY sandston-2021 and not a smaller HTML fixture: every committed legacy-HTML fixture (spatz-2014, reac-2015, sgrp-2019, premier-pacific-2016, tgt-2002, wfc-2008) carries an SGML '10-K' header that `select_and_normalize` trusts over the cover sniff, so a marker on their cover changes nothing; the route ADR-024 calls 'the one that matters more' -- no header, sniff decides -- needs a header-less source, and sandston-2021 is the smallest one committed. MEASURED EFFECT with the fix absent (AMENDMENT_RE replaced by a never-matching pattern, which reproduces origin/main 3c2b8f4's sniff_form exactly): meta.form_type '10-K', form_type_sniffed '10-K', doc_status success_with_warning, warnings ['unattributed_content'], 22 items -- the unmutated source's own envelope, item for item. With the fix: form_type '10-K/A', form_type_sniffed '10-K/A', doc_status unsupported, warnings ['unsupported_form'], 0 items. RED LINE observed through the eval adapter with the fix disabled: '[FAIL] amended-cover-refused' (3 of 6 checks) -- "doc_status 'success_with_warning' != 'unsupported'"; "expected warning 'unsupported_form', got ['unattributed_content']"; "items outside allowed set []: ['1', '1A', '1B', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '7A', '8', '9', '9A', '9B', '9C', '10', '11', '12', '13', '14', '15', '16']". Green with the fix in (6/6). WHY THESE CHECKS: they mirror ksb-unsupported, the existing refused-form case -- doc_status exact (not an 'in' list: the whole finding is that two outcomes are confused), warning_present(unsupported_form) pins the REASON, warning_absent(normalization_collapse) pins that the refusal is by form identity and not by a collapse (102,453 normalized chars, far above COLLAPSE_FLOOR), only_items([]) is the contract's refusal rule (no best-effort items on a refused document), no_empty_success is its counterpart. norm_contains('(Amendment No. 1)') is load-bearing: it proves the marker is in the text the sniff reads, so a future normalizer that dropped it would fail here rather than silently making the refusal rest on nothing. whole_submission_fallback is NOT asserted: the source has no blocks at all, so that warning cannot arise on this route (unlike ksb-2007, a full SGML submission). Tagged 'invariant' because refusing an out-of-scope form honestly, and for the right reason, is not allowed to regress (same reasoning as truncated-download and ksb-unsupported). Registered in evals/bench.py SYNTHETIC so it never sets the ADR-021 §5 sweep multiplier. NOT yet dual-passed by extraction-auditor: pending, per case-authoring step 8.
